Reviewed 2f305d9: switch default Gemini model to `gemini/gemini-3.1-flash-lite` (docs + pinned test updated). No new findings.

comments.body:
Thanks for catching this, Alex, and welcome to the repo! Great first contribution.

The fix is solid and the PR is well written. One small ask: could you switch the default to `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` instead of `gemini-3.8-flash`? That way it stays consistent with the `vertex_ai` provider default you mentioned in the description.

Done: the `gemini` provider default is now `gemini/gemini-3.1-flash-lite`, matching `vertex_ai`. I updated the docstring and the test to match; `tests/sdk/models` passes (526 passed, 8 skipped).


This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
